_about: Single source for every card in the fan and the chapters (build spec §6.6). Video items: adding a real video = encode it (scripts/encode-video.sh) + set src, poster, duration and audio, then run python3 -I scripts/make-images.py. Photo items (type "photo", client feedback 7) are stills shown in the same card frame, with no sound: make-images.py cover-crops `master` to 9:16 around the horizontal `crop` centre into `poster` (720x1280) and `thumb`. A category's optional `rail` lists its rail items in order (else: its videos by `order`); `disabled: true` hides a category everywhere (chapter, fan, icon) while keeping its data (client feedback 6: Skin & hair care is off for now). Titles and the chapter copy are for client approval. stays-07 (pousada-pool) has audio:false and no audio track: the original track was only low handling rumble (about -35 LUFS, nothing above 2 kHz).
